result.title: HimmBO: High-Dimensional Interactive Model-Merging Bayesian Optimization for Image Generation
result.summary: Fine-tuning has become a common way to customize text-to-image models, leading to community collections of over 100K lightweight adapters. Adapters sharing a base model can be merged with continuous coefficients. This turns a large collection into a high-dimensional continuous design space, which recent work explores interactively using preferential Bayesian optimization (PBO). However, existing approaches are limited to a few dozen preselected adapters and require expensive image generation in every interaction round. We introduce HimmBO, a two-stage method that scales preference-driven adapter merging to much larger collections while reducing image-generation cost. Its screening stage recovers the active adapter set through level-set estimation over pre-generated images, requiring no image generation. The refinement stage then optimizes merge coefficients in the recovered low-dimensional subspace. Both stages use a style-aware kernel, allowing preference information to transfer between visually similar adapters. In simulated-user image-matching experiments, HimmBO achieves higher final similarity than all comparisons while reaching a given similarity with under one tenth of the image generations required by prior work. Its performance remains stable as the collection grows to 1080 adapters, while competing methods degrade substantially.

AI.brief_summary: 面向文本到图像适配器合并的高维偏好贝叶斯优化方法：先通过 level-set 估计在预生成图像上筛出活跃适配器子集，再在恢复的低维子空间优化合并系数，并用风格感知核在相似适配器间迁移偏好。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在有限生成预算下先粗筛候选、再在低维子空间精细优化」的思路可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据/候选的高成本筛选与计算分配问题，但研究对象是图像生成适配器合并，与内部推理状态无直接关系。
